name: aavkar-educational-motion-studio
description: Aavkar Educational Motion Studio (AEM): session context, time ledger, guards, render sentinel and review inbox for educational animation work. Every decision is made by the aem CLI.

aemPath.title: aem command
aemPath.description: Path or name of the aem command. Left as 'aem', the plugin also tries ~/.local/bin/aem.

reviewInbox.title: Review inbox
reviewInbox.description: Adds /inbox: a pane listing what waits on you (plan rows, stills, renders, guard denials, imported client comments) with approve and reject buttons. Off by default.
